title: Nespresso Original, Ristretto Italiano, Dark Roast, 50-Count Espresso Pods | Capsules Coffee Pack of 1
features: COFFEE BLEND: A powerful and contrasting espresso blend for the Nespresso Original system. Nespresso Original offers an unforgettable taste through iconic espressos and exceptional coffee discoveries.

COFFEE ORIGIN: South American and East African Arabicas and a touch of Robusta. Slow roasted – Nespresso Intensity 10. Sensorial Profile: A roasty and intense coffee but with fruity notes and a hint of acidity dancing through the blend.

ESPRESSO BREWS 1.35 FL. OZ. and 0.845 FL. OZ.: Savor with Milk: Milk won’t hide Ristretto’s contrasted bouquet. Try this Nespresso coffee with milk - you’ll love how it rounds out the blend and gives it a creamy texture. You won’t want to miss out on a Ristretto Macchiato, just be sure to do so before midday if you’re going for the Italian way.

SUSTAINABILITY FIRST: As a certified B Corporation, Nespresso meets the highest standards of verified social and environmental performance, joining a global movement using business as a force for good.
MACHINE COMPATIBILITY: Nespresso Original pods are not compatible with Vertuo machines.
